summary.headline: Creverse: Largest shareholder Kim Young-hwa amends share pledge; pledged debt cut to KRW 7.0bn
summary.what_happened: Creverse disclosed a corrected filing on Nov 24, 2026 concerning a share pledge contract tied to a change of largest shareholder, made by largest shareholder Kim Young-hwa. The correction reflects a partial repayment of share-backed loans, reducing total borrowings from KRW 7.2bn to KRW 7.0bn and total pledge amount from KRW 9.84bn to KRW 9.46bn. Kim's holding after the correction is 1,805,590 shares (17.64%), and the total number of pledged shares fell from 1,273,725 to 1,263,453.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, share pledges by a largest shareholder are generally disclosed because pledged shares may be sold by lenders if loan terms are breached, which can affect ownership and control. Corrections to such filings typically reflect changes in loan balances or pledged share counts rather than a new transaction.
